decided: M1-M5 fixed after ICP run 1 (registration numbers only) and BEFORE any deviation_gate number was produced by QA. Each is located from the scan (qa/scan_coverage_survey.py -> qa/scan_coverage_survey.json) and cites the INTAKE_CARD coverage table (C1-C6), declared at intake. QA had read the builder's own self-check figures in build/MODELING_PLAN.md §8 (NOT QA) before choosing; no mask was chosen to clear a number. No scan-side mask: the scan holds no unmodelled body; rust/deposit and rim-notch stray points were not located at intake, so any cluster they cause is explained, not masked.

masks.name: M1 C1 downward-facing CAD
masks.why: the scan has almost no downward-facing surface (scanned from above): CAD faces facing down (lug undersides, plate underside, bottom closure) have no scan behind them; their CAD->scan distance is a coverage fact, not a surface deviation
masks.evidence: INTAKE_CARD §3 C1; qa/scan_coverage_survey.json C1_area_frac_nz_lt_-0.5 = 0.25 % of scan area

masks.name: M2 C2 below plate top inside wall
masks.why: no scan exists inside the outer wall below the plate top: the plate underside, the assumed lower inner wall and the closure at the scan extent are assumed geometry (MODELING_PLAN §6) with nothing to compare against
masks.evidence: INTAKE_CARD §3 C2 (scan ends at z -27.84) and C1; qa/scan_coverage_survey.json: 0 scan faces with z < -20.3 and r < 39.5

masks.name: M3 C3 plate interior
masks.why: the plate inside r ~24 is not in the scan; the keyhole, bosses and side hole there are photo-inferred, so no scan distance is meaningful
masks.evidence: INTAKE_CARD §3 C3, §5 F13-F15; qa/scan_coverage_survey.json plate-level coverage: 0 faces r < 22.4, 19 faces r 22.4-24.0

masks.name: M4 C6 outer wall unscanned sector
masks.why: the outer cup wall is not scanned at all over this sector (cup joined to the machine housing there, photos 1-2); the CAD continues the cylinder (assumed) with no scan behind it
masks.evidence: INTAKE_CARD §3 C6 (theta 38-151); located on the scan by QA: outer-wall scan area per 5 deg bin < 5 mm2 for theta 40-150, 15.6 mm2 at 35-40, 46 mm2 at 150-155 vs ~100 elsewhere (qa/scan_coverage_survey.json)

masks.name: M5 open boundary
masks.why: distance from CAD to a scan hole EDGE is not a surface deviation (the scan is open: 5,151 boundary edges / 16 loops)
masks.evidence: INTAKE_CARD §2 scan health; B02 q20_tier2.py:9-10 radius parameter 0.8 mm
